{{Quote|Last I heard, Anakin went to the Yavin system, alone, against orders from Skywalker and Borsk Fey'lya. Young, handsome, reckless, and maybe a little stupid&mdash;definitely my kind of man! Care to introduce us, Kyp?''"<br />"''Why should I? I've nothing against the kid.|Veema and Kyp Durron|<ref name="Dark" />}}
'''Veema''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]&ndash;affiliated [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Kyp's Dozen]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. In [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], [[Kyp Durron|Kyp's]] Dozen participated in the final stages of the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]], where the squadron went up against [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yorik-et|coralskippers]] in an attempt to protect the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Danni Quee]]'s [[Danni Quee's corvette|vessel]] with its [[T-65XJ X-wing starfighter]]s. Leading a trio of other pilots while trying to save a [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] [[Unidentified refugee freighter|freighter]] near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Veema [[Death/Legends|died]] when her fighter lost its wing to opposing fire, sending her XJ [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] crashing into the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Five credits on Octa. And if you beat Veema's score by more than three, Octa, I'll throw in Zero-One as a bonus.|Kyp Durron makes a wager before the Battle of Coruscant|<ref name="Dark" />}}
[[File:Kyp_Durron_Infobox.jpg|thumb|left|210px|Vemma served under Kyp Durron as a lieutenant.]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Veema was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]]<ref name="Dark" /> around [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]].<ref name="ERC" /> She was nearing her fifties during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], when the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] invaded [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to establish a new home. Veema served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the rogue [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyp Durron]]'s [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]&ndash;aligned [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], [[Kyp's Dozen]], which Durron was leading against the forces of the Yuuzhan Vong.<ref name="Dark" /> In [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]],<ref name="ERC" /> the Yuuzhan Vong [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|overwhelmed]] the New Republic's defenses at the latter's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In order to protect the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Danni Quee]], who was bringing with her to Coruscant a new [[Gravitic amplitude modulator|jammer]] meant to disrupt the [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] signals that the Yuuzhan Vong [[yammosk]] creatures produced, Durron took Veema and the rest of Kyp's Dozen on a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] journey to Coruscant.<ref name="Dark" />

During their trek though hyperspace in their [[T-65XJ X-wing starfighter]]s, some of the pilots chatted and made wagers on who would get the most kills, with Veema and the Jedi pilot [[Octa Ramis]] being the favorites. Kyp's Dozen arrived at Coruscant to find the Yuuzhan Vong completing their conquest of the planet, and multiple [[Yorik-et|coralskippers]] engaged Veema and the squadron after Quee's [[Danni Quee's corvette|ship]] and her other escorts arrived nearby. During the fighting, a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] [[Unidentified refugee freighter|freighter]] trying to escape the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]] was attacked by coralskippers, with the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] leading its pursuers toward Quee's ship. To protect Quee and save the freighter, Durron ordered Veema and the three pilots under her command to get the freighter out of the fighting. However, while dealing with the coralskippers, Veema's [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] lost a wing to enemy fire, causing her [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to spin out of control and crash into the freighter, which [[Death/Legends|killed]] Veema and the occupants of the refugee ship. Kyp's Dozen suffered massive casualties during the fighting, with all but Durron, Ramis, and two other pilots perishing, though Quee and her vessel survived.<ref name="Dark" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|For highest kill count, I've got two two credits on Veema. No one can go through males of any species like she can!|Ian Rim|<ref name="Dark" />}}
At the time of her death, Veema had a full-figured appearance. She had a sense of fun that became well known in certain groups, and her inviting smiles in [[Cantina/Legends|taverns]] frequently led to fights. Veema admired youth, handsomeness, and recklessness in men, developing a reputation for going through men of any [[Species/Legends|species]] quickly in romantic endeavors. Despite her sense of fun, Veema held grudges for a long time.<ref name="Dark" />

==Behind the scenes==
Veema appeared in [[Elaine Cunningham]]'s [[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey|''Dark Journey'']], a [[2002]] installment of [[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order|''The New Jedi Order'']] series of novels.<ref name="Dark" />
